prompt: Create an original 60 second orchestral adventure instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: strings, French horn, timpani, flute. Style: rising motifs, dynamic arcs and clear melodic development. Tempo approximately 116 BPM; C major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and grand orchestral piece with a big band feel, featuring prominent brass, woodwinds, and dynamic percussion. It evokes a celebratory and festive atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首活泼宏伟的管弦乐曲，具有大乐队风格，以突出的铜管乐、木管乐和充满活力的打击乐为特色。营造出欢快喜庆的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
